title: Eating Attitudes Test-26 (EAT-26)
reviewNotes: Archived sample selected Q26 (OFTEN) displays a scoring value of 1; the extracted questionnaire maps OFTEN to 0. This explains a one-point total/dieting discrepancy. Source version and reverse-key scoring require review. Do not change the rule merely to fit the example.
The extracted Oral Control item list contains the ambiguous token 1519. It is preserved in guidance but not silently rewritten into item membership.
